title: PRD-04 Medlock trekking line
summary: Cost centre for the Medlock trekking line in unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner DOKAFOR, with £88,048.81 budget remaining for 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre PRD-04 covers the Medlock trekking line operating within manufacturing unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner DOKAFOR [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 at 09:00, the cost centre holds an open status with £88,048.81 of available budget remaining for 2026-Q4 against an allocation of £128,000 [^r1][^r2]. Historical activity includes major component charges such as rim purchase orders placed at the close of August 2026 [^r3].

## Budget and status

Cost centre PRD-04 is currently OPEN in unit NBC-MAN-01 under the responsibility of owner DOKAFOR [^r1]. Master budget details are tracked in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1].

For 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre's financial balances stand as follows:
* Budget amount: £128,000 [^r2]
* Committed spend: £39,951.19 [^r2]
* Available budget: £88,048.81 [^r2]

## Operating transactions

Cost centre PRD-04 was charged for two rim orders on 2026-08-31 [^r3]:
* PO/2026/01097 with a gross value of £64,588.80 [^r3]
* PO/2026/01098 with a gross value of £189,936 [^r3]
